project_tracker_diagnostic: Very tall annual; leaves mostly opposite and commonly palmately 3-lobed; male heads in terminal spikes above clustered female heads.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common, conspicuous, or high-value comparison species for Central Texas field ID.

morphology_keys.habit: Tall, coarse herb, sometimes several meters tall.
morphology_keys.leaves: Mostly opposite; large blades commonly palmately 3-lobed, sometimes 5-lobed, with toothed margins.
morphology_keys.flowers: Male heads in terminal spikes; female heads clustered below.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
